subject: Aboard the colony ship ariadne, in the bay where the work is being done. Lou wants Toby's watch taught to pack a wound and tie off a bleed: two shifts a month, off their posts. "Your people are the ones who'll find the injured first, so they may as well be the ones who don't make it worse. That's a clinical argument, whatever your face is telling me about it." Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.
